# table

```go
import "github.com/lucasassuncao/bezel/component/table"
```

Package table sizes columns to their contents, giving way in a declared order when even that is too wide, and lays cells out in them. Model adds a cursor over the rows, which scroll under a fixed header.

## Constants

<a name="Gap"></a>Gap is the columns between cells.

```go
const Gap = 2
```

<a name="Fit"></a>
## func [Fit](<https://github.com/lucasassuncao/bezel/blob/main/component/table/table.go#L27>)

```go
func Fit(cols []Column, rows [][]string, width int) []int
```

Fit returns each column's width: its widest cell \(title included\) capped at Max, then shrunk to fit width \- Flex first down to Min, then the widest, never below minCell. Min is a floor for shrinking, not a width to grow to.

<a name="Row"></a>
## func [Row](<https://github.com/lucasassuncao/bezel/blob/main/component/table/table.go#L94>)

```go
func Row(widths []int, cells []string) string
```

Row lays cells out in widths, padded to their columns and separated by Gap; the last cell is cut but not padded, so the row ends where it ends.

<a name="Titles"></a>
## func [Titles](<https://github.com/lucasassuncao/bezel/blob/main/component/table/table.go#L111>)

```go
func Titles(cols []Column, widths []int) string
```

Titles is the header row: every column's title in its width.

<a name="Column"></a>
## type [Column](<https://github.com/lucasassuncao/bezel/blob/main/component/table/table.go#L15-L19>)

Column declares one column; Min and Max bound its width \(0 = unbounded\). Flex marks the column that shrinks first: a truncated name is still recognisable, a truncated version is not.

```go
type Column struct {
    Title    string
    Min, Max int
    Flex     bool
}
```

<a name="Item"></a>
## type [Item](<https://github.com/lucasassuncao/bezel/blob/main/component/table/model.go#L20-L23>)

Item is one row of a Model: its cells in column order, and a payload of the caller's type T. A cell may carry its own colour.

```go
type Item[T any] struct {
    Cells []string
    Value T
}
```

<a name="FromValues"></a>
### func [FromValues](<https://github.com/lucasassuncao/bezel/blob/main/component/table/model.go#L149>)

```go
func FromValues[T any](text, sep string) []Item[T]
```

FromValues is the rows of delimited text, one per line, its cells split at sep; blank lines are skipped. The payload is left zero.

Keys are the bindings the table answers to.

```go
type Keys struct {
    Up, Down, PageUp, PageDown, HalfPageUp, HalfPageDown, Top, Bottom, Enter key.Binding
```

```go
func DefaultKeys() Keys
```

DefaultKeys are the arrows, pgup/pgdown, ctrl\+u/ctrl\+d for half a page, home/end and enter.

<a name="VimKeys"></a>
### func [VimKeys](<https://github.com/lucasassuncao/bezel/blob/main/component/table/model.go#L56>)

```go
func VimKeys() Keys
```

VimKeys are DefaultKeys with vim's letters added: k/j to move, g/G to the ends and ctrl\+b/f to page.

## type [Model](<https://github.com/lucasassuncao/bezel/blob/main/component/table/model.go#L70-L79>)

```go
func (m Model[T]) Blur() Model[T]
```

<a name="Model[T].Click"></a>
### func \(Model\[T\]\) [Click](<https://github.com/lucasassuncao/bezel/blob/main/component/table/model.go#L247>)

```go
func (m Model[T]) Click(y int) (Model[T], Action)
```

Click is a left click on line y of View: on a row it moves the cursor there, and on the row already under the cursor it chooses it. The header and the "more" row do nothing. A blurred table takes it too.

```go
func (m Model[T]) SetItems(items []Item[T]) Model[T]
```

SetItems replaces the rows, keeping the cursor on the row with the same first cell when it survives \(at the same index first\), else at the same index: a refresh that drops a row lands on the one that took its place.

```go
func (m Model[T]) Update(msg tea.KeyPressMsg) (Model[T], Action)
```

Update handles one key. Keys the table does not know return None and leave it unchanged, so the caller can layer its own on top.

<a name="Model[T].View"></a>
### func \(Model\[T\]\) [View](<https://github.com/lucasassuncao/bezel/blob/main/component/table/model.go#L284>)

```go
func (m Model[T]) View(th theme.Resolved, width int) string
```

View is the header and the rows in its window, width cells wide. Columns are sized over every row, not the ones shown, so scrolling never moves them. On the cursor row a cell with no colour of its own wears the cursor's.

## type [Styles](<https://github.com/lucasassuncao/bezel/blob/main/component/table/model.go#L82-L87>)

Styles are how a table paints its parts.

```go
type Styles struct {
    Header  lipgloss.Style // the column titles
    Cursor  lipgloss.Style // the cursor row's marker and its plain cells
    Blurred lipgloss.Style // the cursor row's marker while the table is blurred
    More    lipgloss.Style // the "↓ N more" row
}
```
